name: Enūma Eliš
source_label: Enūma Eliš, seven-tablet Babylonian creation poem

surviving_manuscript_date.note: First-millennium copies survive; this seed does not claim the exact earliest physical witness.

estimated_composition.method: Scholarly dating by language, Marduk theology, and historical context; exact composition remains debated.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Set in primordial time; no calendar date.

estimated_oral_origin.method: Earlier Mesopotamian motifs exist, but no date for an oral Enūma Eliš precursor is assigned.

dating.dating_summary: Generally placed in the later second millennium BCE; surviving tablet witnesses are later, so composition and manuscript dates are kept separate.

notes: Motif tags describe the poem only. No borrowing/influence edge is asserted.
